kashika: <<क्तोऽधिकरणे च ध्रौव्यगतिप्रत्यवसानार्थेभ्यः>> [[३.४.७६]] इति वक्ष्यति, तस्येदं ग्रहणम्। अधिकरणवाचिना क्तेन षष्ठी न समस्यते। इदमेषामासितम्। इदमेषां यातम्। इदमेषां भुक्तम्॥
kashikaEnglish: A genitive is not compounded with क्त when क्त denotes location (from roots of fixedness, motion, eating): इदमेषामासितम् 'this is where they sat'.
englishFull:
A sixth-case word is NOT compounded with a क्त-ending word when क्त denotes locality.

When क्त is added to roots of fixedness, motion, or eating, it can mean the location of the action (@ref[3.4.76]).

**No compound:**
मधोः भुक्तः "eaten in/by honey" (location sense)
